researchSections.costScope: Previously recorded intensive research including the 39-keyword completion batch; excludes initial AI-optimized calls whose exact cost was not exposed. Existing task IDs remain on the original rows and completionBatch.

caveats: One exact marble long-tail SERP task returned 40101 Internal SE Server Error with zero reported cost; not represented as successful.
Some SERP organic destination URLs are Google redirect URLs; exact competitor positions and domains should not be generalized.
Suggestion roots marmor/naturstein/reinigung contain retail/product/DIY and textile false positives, excluded from final keyword candidates unless independently relevant.
Volumetric synonyms/variants are not additive; null is provider unknown, not zero.
CPC USD and competition are Ads metrics, not SEO difficulty or conversion proof.

researchSections.selection: Buyer modifiers across existing office/stairwell/property/garage/garden/winter services; archived example-only specialist branch separately.
caveats: Generic terms measured across Germany are not local city search volumes.
Costs and offer modifiers suggest intent, not measured conversions.
Do not add together variants; unknown values remain unknown.
Google Ads location2276/Deutsch measures Germany-wide searches containing the locality, not all searches made inside the named locality.
All 142 exact metrics use the retained volume response; suggestions are discovery only.
Five mobile SERPs are country-targeted snapshots, not a measured local city rank or organic difficulty score.
Some supplied organic destinations are Google goto redirects or irrelevant/mixed results; no easy-ranking or competitor-strength conclusion is drawn.
Routine practice-room cleaning is within scope; sterilization, instrument reprocessing, certified disinfection and guaranteed hygiene outcomes are not advertised.
Similar keyword variants are not additive and CPC USD/Ads competition do not prove conversions or organic SEO difficulty.

researchSections.unexposedCostNote: First live volume request did not expose its charge in the optimized response; cost total excludes that unknown amount. Thirteen unexposed results were obtained in a second full-schema request, not counted twice as researched phrases.

tasks.note: Optimized connector response exposed only first ten rows and no billed cost; live task cannot be read via standard task_get. Do not infer missing metrics or cost.
Only thirteen previously unexposed keyword results requested with full schema.

researchSections.serpLimitations: Germany, German, mobile Android, depth 10. Returned organic destinations included encoded google.com/goto URLs; no exact competitor-ranking or difficulty claim derived from unresolved destinations.

provenance.costNote: Sum of explicitly recorded research sections; excludes early AI-optimized calls whose exact cost was not exposed and is not a complete account billing total. Suggestions, exact volumes and SERP tasks remain separately documented.

definitions.reported_zero: Anbieter meldet numerischen Wert 0. Kein Beweis für dauerhaft fehlende Nachfrage.
definitions.unknown: Abgerufen, aber Anbieter lieferte keinen Suchvolumenwert.
definitions.not_requested: Kandidat noch nicht mit Suchvolumen-Endpunkt abgefragt.
definitions.scope: Deutschlandweit gemessene Suchbegriffe. Ortsname im Suchbegriff ist keine Messung aller Suchen aus diesem Ort.
definitions.variants: Varianten und ähnliche Begriffe nicht summieren.
definitions.intent: Suchabsicht und Priorität sind redaktionelle Einschätzungen, keine gemessene Abschlusswahrscheinlichkeit.
definitions.adsCompetition: Anzeigenwettbewerb und CPC in USD beschreiben Google Ads, keine organische SEO-Schwierigkeit.
definitions.coverage: Themenzuordnung, wörtliche Phrase, lokale Umsetzung, Veröffentlichung und Google-Indexierung werden getrennt geführt.
definitions.scopeApprovalRequired: Nicht bestätigte Spezialmaterial-/Verfahrensleistung. Bei aktiven Kandidaten ohne freigegebenes Angebot bleibt targetURL null und eine Leistungsbestätigung offen. Die 96 ausgeschlossenen Beispielthemen sind ausdrücklich archiviert und kein offener Klärungsauftrag.
definitions.missingTarget: Fehlendes Ziel ist bei scopeApprovalRequired true beabsichtigt. Keine Angebotsroute erfinden. Erst nach bestätigtem tatsächlichem Leistungsumfang und Inhaltsprüfung zuordnen.
definitions.growthFocus: 40 positiv gemessene lokale Fokusbegriffe mit dauerhafter Rangnummer und redaktioneller Auswahlbegründung. Mehrere Varianten teilen eine fachlich passende Seite; keine Conversion-, Klick- oder Rankingprognose.
